method.description: Four V8 heap snapshots in one debug servoshell process at explicit collections 2, 16, 32 and 34; collection 34 runs after the fixture's async entry point settles.
method.snapshot_validation: All four files passed support/v8-smoke/check_heap_snapshot.py. Only the final tagged-probe count is judged; earlier tagged counts and all RovesJsCell counts are diagnostic.

analysis.fixture_entry_global: typeof main is undefined; the prior Window.main fixture root is absent.

findings.interpretation: In this bounded scene, the temporary WeakRef targets pass their release assertions, the retained control remains, the named main-closure root found in the prior fixture is absent, and MemLab reports no increasing collection. Window retained size rises 2.1 KiB between collections 32 and 34; the four-point series alone does not identify a persistent owner or establish a leak.
findings.conclusion: This is evidence for the controlled document-retention fixture only. It does not resolve general JavaScript, cppgc, native-memory, route-transition, or long-session retention.
